title: सूरज डूबते ही गायब हो जाती है परछाई!
topic: एक अनोखा गाँव जहाँ शाम होते ही सबकी परछाइयाँ दीवारों से उतरकर गायब हो जाती हैं और नन्हा कबीर इस रहस्य को सुलझाता है।
description:
सोचिए क्या हो अगर सूरज ढलते ही आपकी परछाई आपका साथ छोड़ दे और कहीं भाग जाए? देखिए कहानी पतंग की यह जादुई और रोमांचक कहानी।
#KahaniPatang #HindiStories #MagicalStory #KidsBedtimeStories #Animation
thumb_visual: English: extreme close-up of 7-year-old Kabir's face with clear shock and wonder, wide eyes, cinematic moonlight lighting, dark room background

characters.Kabir: 7-year-old boy, round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, Indian look

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: सोचिए... अगर आज रात सूरज डूबते ही आपकी परछाई दीवार से उतरकर गायब हो जाए, तो क्या होगा?
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, looking at his wall in an Indian village bedroom at sunset, soft warm lighting, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: यह कोई सपना नहीं है। यह सच है उस गाँव का, जहाँ परछाइयाँ रोज़ शाम को लापता हो जाती हैं!
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, standing in a dimly lit Indian courtyard as evening falls, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अब ध्यान से सुनिए... नन्हे कबीर ने अपनी परछाई को बिस्तर से उठकर खिड़की से बाहर भागते देखा!
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, pointing at a running shadow near a wooden window, night time, close-up shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: कबीर ने फुसफुसाकर कहा, अरे! मेरी परछाई मेरे बिना कहाँ दौड़ चली?
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, looking bewildered inside his rustic bedroom, warm lamp light, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: बिना एक पल गंवाए, कबीर अपनी टॉर्च लेकर परछाई के पीछे चुपचाप भाग निकला।
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, running with a glowing torch in a narrow mud street of an Indian village, night, action shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आप होते कबीर की जगह, तो क्या अंधेरे रास्ते पर अपनी परछाई का पीछा करते?
scenes.style: direct question to viewer, playful tone
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, pausing near an old banyan tree in moonlight, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अचानक, टॉर्च की रोशनी में उसे दर्जनों परछाइयाँ एक पुराने सूखे कुएं के पास नाचती दिखीं!
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, hiding behind a bush and peering at shadows dancing around an old stone well, moonlight, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: क्या वे भूत थीं? नहीं! ध्यान से देखने पर पता चला कि वे तो गाँव के पेड़ों और घरों की परछाइयाँ थीं!
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, watching closely with wide curious eyes near the ancient well, soft moonlight, close-up.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: तभी कबीर की अपनी परछाई मुड़ी और उसने उंगली से कुएं के अंदर झांकने का इशारा किया।
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, watching his own shadow pointing inside the stone well, magical blue glow from the well, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: कबीर ने डरते-डरते कुएं के अंदर झांका और उसकी आँखें फटी की फटी रह गईं!
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, leaning over the edge of the old brick well, bright magical glow reflecting on his face, close-up.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: कुएं की गहराई में एक जादुई नीला स्फटिक चमक रहा था, जो सबकी परछाइयों को अपनी ओर खींच रहा था।
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, looking down at a glowing blue crystal inside the deep well, magical lighting, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: कबीर समझ गया कि परछाइयाँ डरा नहीं रही थीं, बल्कि मदद मांग रही थीं!
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, smiling bravely with determination by the well, soft glowing light, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: उसने एक लंबी लकड़ी उठाई और जादुई पत्थर को हल्का सा हिला दिया।
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, using a long wooden stick to touch the glowing crystal inside the well, dynamic action shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: पूरी ताकत लगाते ही, पत्थर की कैद से सारी परछाइयाँ आज़ाद होकर वापस भागने लगीं!
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, cheering as bright shadows rush back toward the village houses, joyful moonlight, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: कबीर की परछाई दौड़ती हुई आई और वापस उसके पैरों से चिपक गई।
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, looking down happily at his shadow attached to his feet, warm lamp light, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अगले दिन पूरे गाँव में धूप खिली और सबकी परछाइयाँ अपने मालिक के साथ मुस्कुरा रही थीं।
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, smiling happily in the bright sunlight of the village square, wide daytime shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: कबीर की समझदारी ने साबित कर दिया कि डर का सामना करने पर हर रहस्य सुलझ जाता है।
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old boy Kabir with round innocent face, large curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright red cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, waving cheerfully at the camera, bright sunny Indian village background, medium shot.
